name: SWEET CHARIOT POKER
description: Sweet Chariot is a lowball variant of Swingo Poker. Players receive five cards, choose two as hole cards and three as board cards, then use their board cards plus one shared river card and one card from any opponent's board to make their best five-card hand. The lowest hand wins the pot. Played with blinds and pot limit betting.

content.text: Sweet Chariot is a lowball variant of Swingo Poker. Players receive five cards, choose two as hole cards and three as board cards, then use their board cards plus one shared river card and one card from any opponent's board to make their best five-card hand. The lowest hand wins the pot. Played with blinds and pot limit betting.

Swingo Poker was invented by Steve Albini in December 2007 and developed by the Alliance-X poker group in Chicago; it is named after a song by Naked Raygun. Sweet Chariot is a lowball variation of Swingo: same structure but the lowest hand wins at showdown.
Two to eight players; best with five to eight.
Standard deck, poker chips. Stakes (blinds and pot limit) agreed before play.

Small blind by player to dealer's left, big blind by the next player (twice small). Dealer shuffles and deals five cards face down to each player. First betting round; then each player chooses two hole cards and three board cards; all expose board cards. Second betting round. Dealer deals one shared river card face up to the centre. Third betting round. Showdown: lowest hand wins.
